packageRules.description: Group all non-major updates into one weekly PR to cut noise.
Keep the modular CodeMirror 6 set version-aligned (mismatched @codemirror/* majors are a known breakage class).
Keep xterm core + addons + headless aligned (the v5/v6 split was a real footgun).
electrobun is the runtime — surface its majors as their own PR for deliberate review.
